orders.text:
WPMS No. 1938 of 2011
with 
WPMS No. 1939 of 2011
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Ajay Veer Pundir, Advocate for 
the petitioners.
Mr. Rajendra Negi, Advocate, holding 
brief of Mr. Pankaj Purohit, Advocate for 
Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas Parishad.
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties.
Learned counsel for the petitioners
submits that Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas 
Parishad is not executing sale deeds in 
favour of the petitioners under the pretext 
that petitioners have not deposited the 
development charges, as demanded by 
Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas Parishad. He 
further submits that petitioners have 
already deposited the entire price of the 
land, after borrowing money from friends 
and financial institutions, in the year 
2011. He, therefore, submits that, in 
order to utilize the land in question, 
petitioners are ready to deposit the 
development charges, as demanded by 
Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas Parishad, in the 
bank account of Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas 
Parishad, without prejudice to their rights 
and contentions in the writ petitions and 
the deposit so made by the petitioners 
shall be subject to final outcome of these 
writ petitions. 
Learned counsel appearing for Uttar 
Pradesh Avas Vikas Parishad has no 
objection to the proposal made by learned 
counsel for the petitioners. 
In view of the offer so made by the 
learned counsel for the petitioners, it is 
provided that if petitioners deposit the  entire amount of development charges in 
the bank account of Uttar Pradesh Avas 
Vikas Parishad on or before 30.12.2019, 
Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas Parishad shall 
execute sale deeds in favour of petitioners 
on or before 20.01.2020. This, however, 
will be subject to final outcome of these
writ petitions.
List these petitions in the month of 
February, 2020.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) Arpan 12.12.2019

Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
(1) Mr. Tapan Singh & Mr. Ajay Veer 
Pundir, Advocates for the petitioners. 
(2) Mr. B.S. Adhikari, learned counsel 
for respondent nos. 1 & 2. 
(3) Mr. Rahul Consul, learned counsel 
for respondent no. 3.
(4) This Court had directed the Housing 
Commissioner, Uttar Pradesh Avas Vikas 
Parishad and Uttarakhand Housing & 
Development Authority to file their 
personal affidavits within two weeks on 
certain issues. 
(5) Today the matter is listed on an 
application (IA No. 13816 of 2023) filed 
on behalf of respondent nos. 1 & 2, 
whereby further two weeks time has 
been sought for filing personal affidavit 
of Housing Commissioner, Uttar Pradesh 
Avas Vikas Parishad.
(6) Mr. B.S. Adhikari, learned counsel 
appearing for respondent nos. 1 & 2 
submits that the record, regarding 
Improvement Scheme formulated for 
U.P. Avas Vikas Parishad in respect of 
District Haridwar, is being scanned to 
ascertain, as to whether any declaration 
in terms of Section 51 of the U.P. Avas 
Evam Vikas Adhiniyam, 1965 was made  or not. He assures the Court that 
personal affidavit of Housing 
Commissioner, U.P. Avas Vikas Parishad 
shall be filed within two weeks. 
(7) For the reasons indicated in the 
application, the same is allowed. Time 
granted vide order dated 12.10.2023 is 
extended for further two weeks. 
(8) List this case on 29.11.2023.
(9) In the meantime, personal affidavit 
of Housing Commissioner, Uttarakhand 
Housing & Development Authority shall 
also be filed. 
(10) It is made clear that no further 
extension of time shall be given to the 
respondents for the purpose. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.) 
08.11.2023
Aswal
